title: Weekend Box Office 13-15 Nov: Ramayana Rs 196 cr India net 2nd weekend (Sacnilk), above its first (Rs 174 cr); Scene Rs 136.50 cr in 10 days
headline: Ramayana's Second Weekend Beat Its First: ₹196 Crore India Net
caption:
Weekend box office, Friday 13 to Sunday 15 November: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend made ₹196 crore India net across all languages, trade tracker Sacnilk estimates. That is more than it made over its first Friday-to-Sunday weekend.

That first weekend ended on Diwali, Sunday 8 November, when the film made ₹56.15 crore. The holiday Monday after brought ₹107.50 crore, still its biggest day.

Suriya's Scene, in Tamil and Telugu, was a distant second.

Trackers count differently: Bollywood Hungama put Ramayana's second Saturday at ₹68.71 crore, Sacnilk at ₹72.90 crore and Koimoi at ₹76.15 crore.

Which film did you watch in a cinema this weekend?

Sources: Sacnilk, India.com, The Week, DNA India, Bollywood Hungama, Koimoi
